rounds.text: Cresto Techno Limited trades at a highly accessible market capitalisation of just ₹ 31.2 Cr [E2] while offering a compelling 10-year compounded sales growth rate of 17% [E13], proving the underlying business has generated substantial multi-year top-line expansion. The equity is underpinned by a tangible book value of ₹ 8.67 per share against a market price of ₹ 22.5 [E1]. Furthermore, the valuation is exceptionally attractive given a P/E ratio of 0x compared to a sector benchmark of 16.07x [E5], indicating that current earnings are not being factored into the share price at all. The stock also sits at a reasonable 58% of the way up its 52-week range [E4], leaving plenty of room for capital appreciation as sentiment catches up to historical execution. Conceded: the company has delivered a poor sales growth of 0.45% over the past five years [E56] and experienced a 12% contraction in compounded sales over the trailing twelve months [E16].
